description: The suite can't even import the app in CI; no tests actually run.

input.pytest_output:
==================== ERRORS ====================
____ ERROR collecting tests/conftest.py ____
tests/conftest.py:6: in <module>
    import main
E   ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'main'
=============== 1 error in 0.11s ===============
(exit code 2) -- no tests were collected
input.code_context:
CI runs the bare `pytest` console script. main.py lives at the repo root.
There is no pyproject.toml / pytest.ini, no tests/__init__.py, and no root conftest.py.
Under pytest's default import mode, only the tests/ directory is added to sys.path, not the repo root.

expected.root_cause: The repo root is not on sys.path under the bare pytest command, so `import main` fails during collection. This is a packaging/config problem (no pyproject pythonpath setting), not a bug in the application or the tests.
